name: Tanpopo
source:
Always soft and fluffy♫
Sometimes whimpering and weeping...
The little angel that loves you♫

A white pomeranian owned by the protagonist. She really loves being touched and always wants to be petted. Although she doesn't initiate physical contact that much, she absolutely loves being on the receiving end of it.
She loves the protagonist and when he's about to go out, she'll whimper as she sees him off, making him feel a bit guilty. As time draws near for the protagonist to come home, she waits eagerly at the door.

”E-ehehe, your headpats make me so happy♫
...But, why did you give me three whole pets less than yesterday?"
